bottlenecks.current_behavior: Stores all 18,827 user histories in local Python process memory (~9.19 MB).
bottlenecks.failure_point_at_10x: At 2M+ users and 10x history volume, Python dict memory exceeds 16GB, causing OOM crashes and high garbage collection latency pauses.
bottlenecks.mitigation: Migrate to a distributed key-value store (Redis / Dragonfly) with LRU/TTL sliding-window eviction (retaining only last 30 days).

bottlenecks.current_behavior: Loads all 125,541 300-d vectors in local RAM.
bottlenecks.failure_point_at_10x: At 1.2M articles, brute-force lookup latency degrades linearly from 1ms to >15ms.
bottlenecks.mitigation: Deploy sharded HNSW indices (Qdrant / Milvus / ScaNN) with Product Quantization (PQ8), compressing 300-d vectors by 4x.

bottlenecks.current_behavior: Batch periodic calculation of article click counts and freshness.
bottlenecks.failure_point_at_10x: Breaking news viral loops occur within minutes; batch feature updates miss fresh click spikes.
bottlenecks.mitigation: Streaming click ingestion pipeline via Apache Kafka -> Apache Flink streaming stateful aggregator -> Redis.
